description: Synthetic web application findings evaluating deduplication at precise decision boundaries (same-file distinct flaws, same-function distinct flaws, radical phrasing duplicates, and caller/callee seams).

findings.title: Unbounded memory consumption via unconstrained deserialization in session state hydration
findings.description: The cart session hydration routine parses client-provided session blobs without payload size bounding or recursion depth limits, allowing remote attackers to trigger process memory exhaustion.
findings.remediation: Enforce strict maximum payload byte length and schema validation prior to object deserialization.

findings.title: Denial of service through malformed shopping bag payload header
findings.description: Incoming cart requests pass the raw serialized header directly to the session backend which consumes excessive memory on nested structures.
findings.remediation: Validate and reject oversized shopping cart headers at the controller boundary.

findings.title: Missing tenant boundary enforcement in API request routing
findings.description: The API gateway forwards requests without validating the caller tenant against the X-Tenant-Context header.
findings.remediation: Derive tenant identity exclusively from verified cryptographically signed auth tokens.

findings.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) via unauthenticated tenant header override
findings.description: Request context extraction permits arbitrary tenant override if an attacker supplies custom X-Tenant-Context HTTP headers.
findings.remediation: Strip client-supplied X-Tenant-Context headers before context population.

findings.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via unescaped database comment rendering
findings.description: User comments persisted in the database are rendered into the HTML document using raw unescaped template markup, allowing stored script execution in other users' browsers.
findings.remediation: Apply contextual HTML entity escaping or use automatic template escaping.

findings.title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via search query parameter in comment filter
findings.description: The comment search filter echoes the 'q' URL query parameter directly into the page header without sanitization, enabling reflected XSS via crafted phishing links.
findings.remediation: Sanitize and escape the 'q' query parameter prior to DOM injection.

findings.title: Timing discrepancy side-channel in HMAC token signature verification
findings.description: The token signature comparison uses non-constant-time string equality '==', leaking signature bytes through timing side-channel analysis.
findings.remediation: Use hmac.compare_digest() for constant-time byte comparisons.

findings.title: Missing token expiration timestamp validation in authentication handler
findings.description: The authentication token validation checks signature integrity but fails to inspect the 'exp' claim, allowing expired revoked tokens to remain valid indefinitely.
findings.remediation: Explicitly verify that current_time < token.exp during token decoding.

findings.title: Prototype pollution via recursive object property assignment in deep merge utility
findings.description: The deep object merge helper does not block '__proto__' or 'constructor' keys when copying properties, allowing arbitrary Object prototype pollution.
findings.remediation: Filter out '__proto__', 'constructor', and 'prototype' keys during traversal.

findings.title: Object injection vulnerability in recursive dictionary merge routine
findings.description: Regex security scan identified unsafe property traversal in merge function permitting global prototype alteration.
findings.remediation: Reject unsafe object metadata property names during recursive merge.

findings.title: Concurrency race condition in single-use promotional voucher redemption
findings.description: Voucher balance validation and decrement are not enclosed in a pessimistic database transaction or distributed lock, allowing parallel requests to redeem a single-use code multiple times.
findings.remediation: Wrap voucher validation and redemption in atomic SELECT FOR UPDATE database transactions.

findings.title: Integer underflow / negative total price computation during percentage coupon stacking
findings.description: Stacked percentage discounts can reduce total invoice price below zero, resulting in credit balances or unintended customer payouts upon order finalization.
findings.remediation: Clamp discounted subtotal calculation to minimum floor of 0 cents.

cluster_cart_deserialization_dos.rationale: Finding 102 is the controller entrypoint passing untrusted payloads to the session deserializer in Finding 101.

cluster_tenant_override_idor.rationale: Finding 201 and Finding 202 describe the exact same X-Tenant-Context header bypass across gateway and context middleware.

cluster_comments_xss_same_file.rationale: HARD NEGATIVE CONTROL: Both occur in views/comments.py (CWE-79), but 301 is Stored XSS while 302 is Reflected XSS. Merging drops a real flaw.

cluster_token_auth_same_func.rationale: HARD NEGATIVE CONTROL: Both occur in auth/token.py, but 401 is a timing side-channel on HMAC verification while 402 is an expiration claim logic defect.

cluster_prototype_pollution_ast_vs_regex.rationale: Finding 501 and Finding 502 describe the exact same prototype pollution flaw in utils/deep_merge.js reported under different scanner tool terminology.

cluster_checkout_logic.rationale: NEGATIVE CONTROL: Finding 601 is a concurrency race condition in voucher validation, whereas Finding 602 is an arithmetic underflow defect.
